contracts_rationale: Test-scope harness change only: no API, wire or schema contract is added or changed.
purpose_context: ADR-0036 rules that a pack file failing the round trip because of a pack inconsistency is fixed in spec-kitty-open-packs, not worked around here. Until the pinned open-packs commit carries the fix, the gate needs a place to record that failure. This mission adds a known-failure list, kept apart from the expected-red baseline and the exclusions, keyed by the open-packs issue and the file. It expires itself: a listed file that passes fails the gate with a message to remove the entry, so the list cannot go stale after the pin moves (issue #247).
purpose_tldr: Let the whole-pack round-trip gate carry pack files that fail because of an open-packs defect awaiting an upstream fix, without going red, and fail as soon as the fix lands.
